Name: Full-Beacon Smoke Test (one of each)
Description:
Comprehensive smoke stack: brings up ultravisor + ultravisor-auth-beacon (memory provider, admin login) PLUS exactly one of every web-UI beacon (retold-databeacon, retold-facto, retold-content-system, retold-remote, retold-data-mapper) and one of every worker beacon (retold-synth-databeacon for source data, meadow-integration for parse/transform).  retold-remote also auto-registers orator-conversion as a sibling beacon, so the MediaConversion capability shows up on the mesh without an extra component.  All beacons are pre-wired to log in as `admin` / UVAdminPassword.

Use this preset to verify: (a) every beacon image builds, (b) every beacon registers with UV's auth beacon, (c) every beacon's web UI loads the login overlay, (d) the cross-beacon data-mapping pipeline runs end-to-end.

Integration walkthrough after `Up`:
  1. Open the data-mapper UI at http://127.0.0.1:${input.DataMapperPort}, sign in as admin.
  2. The 'smoke-databeacon' connection is pre-bootstrapped — the mapper's BeaconBrowser shows synth-databeacon (source) + smoke-databeacon (target).
  3. Pick synth-databeacon ▸ Company as Source.  Pick smoke-databeacon ▸ Company as Target (will be auto-created on first write).
  4. Map IDCompany, Name, City, StateCode, CreateDate 1:1.
  5. Save the mapping + click Run.  ~25 rows flow through synth → meadow-integration's TabularTransform → databeacon's MeadowProxy.Create.
  6. Confirm rows landed: open databeacon UI at http://127.0.0.1:${input.DataBeaconPort}, browse the Company table.

DataRoot.Description: Base directory for all volume mounts (UV state + each beacon's data dir).  Subdirectories created on first launch.

MonorepoRoot.Description: Path to your retold monorepo checkout.  All retold-* and meadow-integration images are built from MonorepoRoot/modules/... at launch.

UVAdminPassword.Description: Bootstrap admin password.  Used as the login credential across every beacon web UI in this stack AND as the bearer password every beacon presents at registration.

UVPort.Description: Host port for the Ultravisor API + web UI.

DataBeaconPort.Description: Host port for retold-databeacon (smoke target — SQLite-backed; the mapper writes Company rows here).

FactoPort.Description: Host port for retold-facto (registers + login overlay; no role in the integration).

ContentSystemPort.Description: Host port for retold-content-system (registers + login overlay; serves an empty content dir).

RemotePort.Description: Host port for retold-remote (registers + auto-registers orator-conversion alongside; serves an empty content dir).

DataMapperPort.Description: Host port for retold-data-mapper (where the smoke integration is configured + run from the UI).

SynthBeaconPort.Description: Host port for retold-synth-databeacon (source of the smoke dataset).
